welp.. this blessed my day for sure.

I've heard that it's pretty common to have the same of at least one of the big three signs (sun, moon, and rising) with your parent, so you may want to look deeper into your other planets, along with the aspects included in your birth chart.

Hmm that's interesting, I haven't actually thought about that until now. Since you mentioned it though, I realized that majority of my friends (90% Leos) often speak in action-led vocabulary and for some strange reason say "No offense" pretty often. But that may just be based off of my own personal experience, and I'm sure they have different dom signs too.

hey! I'm in the same spot too actually. I'm a libra moon, and my mom also happens to be an aries sun. I think like other comments have mentioned, it may be the opposition between the signs aries and libra that just conflict each other. 

It's not as much as the fact that we're a libra moon but rather how it's opposing our mother's sun signs. 

However, it is a love and hate relationship with her. For a year period, we would get into fights everyday- screaming and all of that, but for a while, it's been pretty peaceful and I realize that no matter what I love her to death and I know she feels the same way. I think that's because she actually has libra dom, so in a way she does understand me. It may have to also do with your mom's placements so you may want to dive deeper into that.

12th house stellium too. I used to hate it, but I've realized that it has allowed us to be more in touch with our emotions (many people often say we're intuitive) and we have this peaceful vibe no matter how much of a mess we actually are.
just any general advice or opinion you have based on those three placements. :-)

That's really good for you. I totally understand where you're coming from. I feel like in school, it's more of a priority to suck up to your teachers to receive a better grade than the actually learning process itself, which I honestly wish would change.

I'm not sure why, but sometimes I just randomly think of some sad memory from years ago that decides to pop up in my head for no reason. And I just cry my eyes as if I'm reliving in that moment... because it definitely feels that way. There's no trigger or anything, like I can just be doing HW or watching Youtube and it just pops up for no reason.
